description.en:
Booster K1 is a compact humanoid platform for robotics education, research and competition activities. At a listed height of 95 cm and mass of 19.5 kg, it provides a smaller development system than a full-size industrial humanoid. Its 22 degrees of freedom support whole-body motion experiments and coordinated behaviors.

The platform combines stereo-depth sensing and audio interfaces with software tools for application development. Booster offers multiple computing configurations, so onboard processing capacity depends on the edition. The SDK and Booster Gym development environment support work on motion policies, simulation and robot control, including research and teaching activities associated with humanoid soccer and other dynamic tasks.
